title: Tigers : Can A Salesman Be A Hero
desc: A pharma salesman in Pakistan takes on his own company after discovering they knowingly marketed harmful baby formula, risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
desc: City boy Ram falls for village girl Sona, raised by her strict brother Raghuveer. After Ram's mother insults Sona, Raghuveer challenges Ram to prove he's worthy of marrying her.

title: Waqt-The Race Against Time
desc: Ishwar, facing terminal illness, decides to kick his son out to teach him responsibility. It's a tough love lesson that sparks growth and unexpected challenges.

title: Dil Chahta Hai
desc: Three inseparable friends drift apart after college-Akash moves to Australia, Sameer chases love, and Siddharth immerses in art-each following a different path.

title: Dhadak
desc: Madhu and Parthavi fall in love despite social differences. Families oppose them, forcing the couple to elope, while her father and brother chase relentlessly, testing their bond.

title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

title: Kesari
desc: Havildar Ishar Singh leads 21 brave Sikh soldiers against 10,000 Pashtun invaders, creating one of history's greatest last stands of courage and sacrifice.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Krazzy 4
desc: A doctor takes four intellectually disabled patients to a cricket match but gets kidnapped. The four team up with a TV channel girl to find and rescue her.

title: Saagar
desc: Raja secretly loves Mona, but she loves Ravi. Ravi's grandmother disapproves, forcing Mona to choose between love and family, leaving Raja heartbroken yet hopeful.

title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
desc: Sattu, a failed lawyer, dreams of marrying Katha, a girl out of his league. Fate unites them, and Sattu tries to win her love with sincerity.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.
